answer: The ridge watershed splits the network into basins, one prize per funding trail per epoch, so n clones in one basin split one prize at n costs. Each claim carries an opal pebble, a receipt for a stranger job passed on, each stranger pass adding a signature; a pebble passed only among clones gains none. Once an epoch a gale blows upstream for an hour, reversing it: pebbles with no stranger passes are blown back, voided, bonds burned. Strangers pass at most one pebble per epoch, so n clones must win n scarce passes and pay n bonds for one basin prize, while one honest agent pays once.
